title: Attio scale stats
description: A white framed section about scale: a blue badge, a two-tone 40px heading and four big figures in a 2×2 grid, each with a 2px blue rule on its left; behind them an exponential growth line sweeps from the bottom left to the top right corner over a field of vertical hairlines and a faint blue wash. The blue line draws itself over a grey twin as the section scrolls up, and the figures come out of a blur one by one.
notes: on phones the line sits below the figures in a 240px strip
CSS only (the line is a plain SVG path)
